description: Source code for the OpenClawChatViewModel class, which manages chat interactions, session data, message reconciliation, and communication with the OpenClaw chat transport layer in a Swift-based application.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: Manages chat session state, message exchange, and interaction with the transport layer in a SwiftUI or UIKit application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes and loads chat session data, including fetching history and models.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the chat session state by re-fetching history and related data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a user message, handling special commands and updating UI optimistically.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of chat sessions.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches the current chat session to the specified session key.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Updates the current thinking level for the session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects a specific model for the chat session.
